name: Muhammad Raihan Nugraha
title: Software Engineering
motto: An Endeavour Through Knowledge, Technology & Leadership.
principle: FORESIGHT IN VISION. ENDEAVOUR IN ACTION.
summary: Fresh graduate majoring in Software Engineering (RPL) from SMKN 1 Cimahi with strong achievements and dedication to technology. Possesses a solid academic track record as a top graduate and overall academic champion, combined with organizational leadership experience as a former student council president (OSIS). Equipped with software development, data analysis, and graphic design skills, and capable of effective communication and teamwork.
philosophy: I am a disciplined, fast-learning individual committed to delivering the best results. Ready to work, contribute, and continue growing alongside the company.

title: Disaster Management & Logistics Information System
overview: Developed an integrated web and mobile platform for disaster response and logistics management for the Social Affairs Office of Cimahi City.
problem: Disaster response coordination relied on fragmented manual reporting, making resource tracking and logistics distribution slow and error-prone during critical moments.
objectives: Unify disaster reporting, logistics inventory, and response coordination into a single accessible platform for both web and mobile users.
role: Full-stack developer — architecture, web development, and mobile integration.
process: Requirements gathered with the Social Affairs Office, followed by iterative development: database design, REST API layer with Laravel, responsive web dashboard with React/Next.js, and a companion mobile app with Flutter.

title: Mobile Health Management System
overview: Built a dedicated mobile application to streamline health records and medical management for the Youth Red Cross (PMR) at SMKN 1 Cimahi.
problem: PMR members tracked health records and medical supplies on paper, causing data loss and slow retrieval during events and check-ups.
objectives: Digitize member health records and simplify medical data management for PMR administrators.
role: Native Android developer — UI design, local storage architecture, and testing.
process: Designed around the PMR workflow, built natively in Kotlin with structured local persistence and form-driven data entry.

title: Interactive Chess Game Application
overview: Designed and developed an interactive mobile chess game featuring responsive gameplay mechanics.
problem: Exploring game logic implementation — turn management, legal move validation, and check/checkmate detection in a touch-first environment.
objectives: Deliver smooth, responsive chess gameplay on mobile with complete standard rules.
role: Game logic and Android developer — engine design and UI.
process: Implemented the full chess rule engine in Kotlin, including piece movement validation, and wrapped it in an interactive touch interface.

title: Pastry Cafe Point of Sale System
overview: Engineered a dual-platform web and desktop POS solution tailored for bakery and cafe operations.
problem: Pastry and cafe transactions needed a system that works both at the counter (desktop) and across the business (web dashboard).
objectives: Provide reliable order processing, stock tracking, and sales reporting across web and desktop platforms.
role: Full-stack developer — backend with Laravel, desktop client with WPF (.NET & C#).
process: Built a shared Laravel backend and API, then delivered two frontends: a web dashboard and a WPF desktop cashier application.

title: School Management Information System Mobile App
overview: Created a mobile application to digitize and manage administrative and academic information for SMKN 1 Cimahi.
problem: School administrative and academic data was managed across disconnected manual channels, slowing information distribution to students and staff.
objectives: Centralize school information access in one mobile application for students and administration.
role: Cross-platform mobile developer — app architecture and implementation.
process: Developed with Flutter (Dart) and JavaScript, structuring academic and administrative modules with clean navigation.

title: Ramen Restaurant Point of Sale System
overview: Developed a comprehensive desktop and web-based POS application to manage restaurant orders, billing, and inventory.
problem: Restaurant order flow, billing, and stock were handled manually, creating bottlenecks during peak hours.
objectives: Streamline the full restaurant operation cycle: ordering, billing, and inventory control.
role: Desktop and web developer — Windows Forms client and Laravel backend.
process: Built the cashier desktop client in C# Windows Forms connected to a Laravel-powered backend for menu, order, and inventory data.

title: IoT Museum Painting Security System
overview: Built an Internet of Things hardware and software security prototype designed to protect museum paintings from unauthorized access or theft.
problem: Museum paintings needed a low-cost, responsive detection system for unauthorized handling.
objectives: Detect and alert on unauthorized contact or movement of exhibited paintings.
role: IoT engineer — sensor integration, C++ programming, and alert logic.
process: Programmed Arduino UNO sensors in C++ to detect interference and trigger alarm responses in real time.

role: Ketuplak Magang Program Kerja Jurusan (Internship Program Committee Chair)
org: Software Engineering Department — Angkatan 22, SMK Negeri 1 Cimahi
contribution: Appointed as Committee Chair (Ketuplak) for the Internship Work Program (Program Kerja Magang) of the Software Engineering Department, Cohort 22, at SMKN 1 Cimahi. Led the committee responsible for bridging students with industry internship placements: mapping partner companies, distributing and validating internship required documents, monitoring student attendance and progress reports, and serving as the main liaison between students, supervising teachers, and industry mentors. Developed leadership at scale, program administration, and professional networking with industry partners.
